features.title: Signed-in user deletes their own account from the Account screen
features.benefit: Delete your Chimes account yourself, from the Account screen, at any time.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer sets the area they want alerts for
features.benefit: Choose the area you care about, by postcode and radius, and Chimes tells you when an ice cream van comes into it.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer sees their alert circle on the map
features.benefit: See the exact area Chimes is watching for you, drawn on the map.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer fills in their postcode from where they are standing
features.benefit: Away from home? Tap the crosshair and Chimes finds your postcode for you.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer is alerted when a van comes into their area
features.benefit: Chimes tells you the moment an ice cream van comes into your area, even with the app closed.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer is alerted once per visit, not again and again
features.benefit: One alert when a van arrives, not a buzz every time its position updates.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Customer is not alerted about a van that is Offline or not approved
features.benefit: You only hear about vans that are really out trading.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: iPhone customer gets the alert with the app closed or in the background
features.benefit: The Chimes tune and the van's name arrive on your lock screen, app open or not.

features.area: Customer alert area and vendor-arrival alerts
features.title: Android customer gets the alert with the app closed or in the background
features.benefit: The Chimes tune and the van's name arrive on your Android phone, app open or not.

features.area: Customer identity, signed-in customers, permission state
features.title: Customer uses Chimes without an account
features.benefit: No account needed: open Chimes and it works.

features.area: Customer identity, signed-in customers, permission state
features.title: A postcode that could not be checked is not called invalid
features.benefit: If Chimes cannot look up your postcode, it tells you why instead of calling a good postcode wrong.

features.title: Customer favourites a vendor from its card
features.benefit: Tap the heart on any vendor to save them, so you can find them again.

features.title: Customer removes a favourite from its card
features.benefit: Changed your mind? Tap the filled heart to take a vendor off your favourites.

features.title: My favourites are still there when I come back
features.benefit: Your favourite vendors are saved and waiting every time you open Chimes.

features.title: Customer opens the favourites list from the map
features.benefit: One tap on the heart button shows all your favourite vendors, whether or not they are on screen.

features.title: Each favourite in the list says in words whether the vendor is out now
features.benefit: See at a glance which favourite vans are out now and when the others were last seen.

features.title: Tapping a live or listed favourite shows the vendor above the card
features.benefit: Tap a favourite in your list and the map flies to that vendor.

features.title: Customer removes a favourite from the list with its heart
features.benefit: Tidy your favourites straight from the list with one tap.

features.title: A favourite vendor's pin carries a small heart
features.benefit: Your favourite vans and shops wear a small heart on the map, so you spot them at once.

features.title: Customer sees open-data ice cream listings on the map
features.benefit: See ice cream vans and shops near you, even ones that are not on Chimes yet.

features.title: Customer sees a Chimes business in colour among the listings
features.benefit: Businesses that have joined Chimes stand out from the open-data listings with the colour Chimes cone.

features.title: Customer sees a Live van at its position with the vendor's own icon
features.benefit: Watch the van come down the road: it shows on the map with its own picture, where it is now.

features.title: A moving van pulses on the map
features.benefit: A pulsing ring tells you which vans are on the move.

features.title: An Offline van is drawn faded with a "zZ" badge
features.benefit: A van that is out of sight stays on the map, faded and marked as sleeping, so you know it exists.

features.title: Tapping a marker opens its card; tapping the map closes it
features.benefit: Tap a van or a shop to see its name, how to contact it and, for a Live van, how to get to it.

features.title: The card of a Live van shows it is live and how to reach it
features.benefit: See that a van is live right now, when it last reported, and get directions to it.

features.title: The card of a listing shows how to contact the business
features.benefit: Find a business's website, social pages, email and phone number straight from the map.

features.title: The card of a van that is not live says why
features.benefit: Tap a faded van to see whether it is Offline or just not in your area.

features.title: Customer opens a filter panel and chooses what the map shows
features.benefit: Show only the vendors you care about: Chimes vendors, live vans, or your favourites.

features.title: Customer sees their own position as a blue dot
features.benefit: See where you are on the map, next to the vans and the area you chose.

features.title: A new customer sees Quick Start before the Map
features.benefit: A short Quick Start guide the first time you open Chimes shows you how to set your area and what tapping a van does.

features.title: A customer can reread Quick Start from Settings
features.benefit: Open the Quick Start guide again from Settings whenever you need a reminder.

features.title: A customer can follow Chimes on Facebook and Instagram
features.benefit: Follow Chimes on Facebook and Instagram for news and updates.

features.title: A customer can share Chimes with a friend
features.benefit: Share Chimes with friends by QR code, link or the App Store.

features.title: A customer can send the Chimes team a message
features.benefit: Contact the Chimes team from the app with feedback, questions or a vendor sign-up request.

features.title: Chimes runs on iPhone, iPad and Android
features.benefit: Chimes runs on iPhone, iPad and Android phones.

features.title: Customer sees whether alerts are on or off
features.benefit: See at a glance whether Chimes will tell you when a van is nearby.

features.title: Customer turns alerts on
features.benefit: Switch on arrival alerts and Chimes tells you when an ice cream van enters your area.

features.title: Customer turns alerts off
features.benefit: Don't want alerts any more? Switch them off in Settings at any time.

features.title: Customer is offered a newer version
features.benefit: Chimes tells you when a newer version is ready, so you always have the latest fixes.

features.title: A Live van keeps publishing while the phone is locked
features.benefit: Drive your round with your phone locked in the cab: customers still see where your van is.

features.title: Background publishing stops when the vendor stops sharing
features.benefit: Tap Stop Sharing and your phone stops reporting your position at once, even when Chimes is in the background.

features.title: Vendor is told when background updates are off
features.benefit: If your phone cannot keep sharing in the background, Chimes tells you so before you drive off.

features.title: A van registered for live tracking starts in Demo mode
features.benefit: Try Chimes with your own van and your own phone for free: you start in demo mode, then the Chimes team switches you to fully live.

features.title: A free-listing vendor who starts sharing their location becomes a Demo van
features.benefit: Started with a free listing? Tap Start sharing to put your van on the map, in demo mode first.

features.title: A Demo van sees an orange banner on the Map
features.benefit: The Map tells a demo van owner clearly that updates are limited, and how to get a free live trial.

features.title: A Demo van publishes its position at most once per interval
features.benefit: In demo mode your van is updated about once an hour, so you can try Chimes without a live service.

features.title: Vendor sets a home area on a map
features.benefit: Mark your home or yard on a map and pick a size, and Chimes keeps your van private there.

features.title: Vendor finds their home by postcode
features.benefit: Type your postcode and Chimes moves the map there.

features.title: Vendor uses their current location as home
features.benefit: Standing in your yard? One tap puts the home area on it.

features.title: The saved circle is moved and enlarged on purpose
features.benefit: Your exact yard is never stored or shown: the circle is nudged and made a little bigger, so it still covers you.

features.title: Vendor removes the home area
features.benefit: Changed your mind? Remove the home area and your van goes back to sharing as normal.

features.title: A van that parks or dwells inside the home area goes Offline by itself
features.benefit: Get home and forget to stop sharing? Chimes takes your van Offline when it parks in your home area.

features.title: The van goes Live again when it leaves the home area
features.benefit: Drive off for your round and Chimes puts you back on the map, with no tap needed.

features.title: A position inside the home area is never published
features.benefit: Whatever else happens, Chimes never sends the position of your van while it is in your home area.

features.title: Going Live by hand inside the home area shows the van there
features.benefit: If you choose to share while at home, Chimes does what you asked and shows your van, then protects the yard again once you drive off.

features.title: The home area is drawn on the vendor's own map and goes nowhere else
features.benefit: You see your home area on your own map. Nobody else ever does.

features.title: Location Sharing shows what the home area is doing
features.benefit: Location Sharing tells you whether your home area is set and whether you are inside it.

features.title: Vendor opens the home area in a view mode and edits on request
features.benefit: Look at your home area without moving it by accident, then tap Edit to change it, or Cancel to put it back.

features.title: Saving a home area that moves the van out puts it Live
features.benefit: Move your home area away from where you are and your van goes Live straight away.

features.area: Vendor live / offline sharing, Go Offline daily, publishing cadence
features.title: Vendor sees whether they are Live or Offline
features.benefit: Always know whether customers can see your van: Live or Offline, on the map and in Location Sharing.

features.area: Vendor live / offline sharing, Go Offline daily, publishing cadence
features.title: Vendor stops sharing with one tap
features.benefit: Finished your round? Tap Stop Sharing and customers no longer see where your van is.

features.area: Vendor live / offline sharing, Go Offline daily, publishing cadence
features.title: Vendor shares their location with one tap
features.benefit: Starting your round? Tap Share Location and customers can see your van.

features.area: Vendor live / offline sharing, Go Offline daily, publishing cadence
features.title: Vendor goes Offline automatically at a set time every day
features.benefit: Never forget to stop sharing: pick a time and Chimes takes you Offline every day.

features.title: Vendor says what they sell in a line of text
features.benefit: Tell customers what you sell in a line, like "Soft-serve, sundaes and slush".

features.title: Customer sees what a vendor sells on its card
features.benefit: Tap a van or vendor on the map to see what they sell.

features.title: Vendor registers a free listing
features.benefit: Put your business on the Chimes map for free: enter your email, type the code we send, and set up your listing.

features.title: Vendor registers for live van tracking
features.benefit: Want customers to see your van move? Register for a free trial of live tracking.

features.title: New free-listing vendor sets up their listing straight after registering
features.benefit: Add your name, town, postcode and links, and your pin is on the map in minutes.

features.title: Vendor signs in with an emailed code
features.benefit: Sign in with your email: we send you a code, no password to remember.

features.title: Vendor stays signed in between launches
features.benefit: Sign in once and stay signed in; no code each time you open the app.

features.title: Vendor chooses where customers see their van
features.benefit: Choose whether customers see your van only when you are in their area, or anywhere on the map as they watch you head their way.

features.title: Customer sees a map-wide van anywhere on the map
features.benefit: Watch a van heading your way before it reaches you: vans that choose "Everywhere on the map" show wherever they are.

features.title: Customer sees an Offline van as an Offline icon at its postcode area
features.benefit: A van that is out of sight is not forgotten: see where it is based, marked Offline, without showing where it really is.
